answer: A payout is split and therefore 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The wharf schedule is applied in bridge and dawn reveals each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4037 identities would post 4871 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
